task: detect shield machine cutterhead clogging
note: Abstract says K-means SMOTE was applied to the clogging features of the training set only. Contribution is LSTM-autoencoder cleaning plus enhanced transformer detector; sensor time slices turned into time-domain features.

task: classify imbalanced streaming data with concept drift
note: Generic pipeline (ADASYN, ADWIN drift detection, tuned DNN) evaluated on NSL-KDD intrusion, Spam and Chess benchmarks; domain coded security from two of three data sets.

task: flag fraudulent card transactions
note: Conditional GAN described as CTGAN-inspired, no stated change to the generator (B2), combined with cost-weighted losses; Kaggle credit-card data; expected financial cost reported. Zenodo preprint.

task: classify criticality of admitted hospital patients
note: Borderline under B: SMOTE in an LLE embedding (existing parts) and dataset trimming are offered as balancing strategies, but the contribution is the patient classification; abstract names no specific measure.

task: classify FTIR spectra images of ligands and metal complexes
note: Chemometrics (chemistry), so domain other. Random oversampling of images; error rate and false positive rate also reported (other).

task: screen children for ADHD inattentive subtype
note: 39 participants, leave-one-out cross-validation; locally deep SVM best of nine classifiers; SMOTE applied to game segment data, results reported with and without SMOTE in the abstract.

task: classify wall-following robot movement direction
note: Robotics (24 ultrasound sensors). Genetic programming symbolic classifier, 5-fold CV on oversampled data sets, final test on the original data set, which overlaps the training data.

task: predict diabetes mellitus status from laboratory data
note: Abstract says several resampling techniques were compared but names only SMOTE; 484 records, Optuna tuning.

task: assess building fire risk
note: Bayesian network learned from SMOTE-expanded fire history data plus expert knowledge; domain coded environment (hazards); abstract names no measure and no evaluation design.

task: classify breast lesions on ultrasound RF B-mode images
note: VGG16-CapsNet hybrid; abstract reports an experiment balancing by class weights against SMOTE (vs_weights would likely be yes with the full text). 220 data points from 118 patients.

task: detect malware from hybrid static and dynamic features
note: Abstract says various oversampling techniques were used but does not name them, so resampler na. Genetic programming symbolic classifier, 5-fold CV; best expressions re-applied to the original imbalanced data set.

task: predict stroke risk
note: SMOTE applied during preprocessing; contribution is DiCE counterfactual explanations for a random forest. Book chapter.

task: classify ECG heartbeats into arrhythmia classes
note: SMOTE named only in the closing sentence; focal loss with adaptive class weights also used. MIT-BIH and INCART evaluated separately with different class systems, so internal.

task: detect maize lodging at plot scale from UAV images
note: SMOTE-ENN (existing) applied to features extracted from UAV visible and multispectral images, then XGBoost with SHAP; no comparison with other resampling named in the abstract.

task: monitor short-term voltage stability of power systems online
note: FN-SMOTE is integrated with cost-sensitive learning as named techniques, not presented as new here; it may be the authors' own earlier variant. Learner not named. Nordic test system and real CSG grid. Book chapter.

task: predict heart failure mortality
note: SMOTE-ENN applied first, then feature selection and the proposed boost-stacked ensemble classifier; contribution is the classifier.

task: detect abnormal states of stock market trading system components
note: IT operations fault detection from system log statistics, so software, not finance. Abstract says oversampling techniques were used but does not name them; learners C4.5, naive Bayes, bagging, random forest.

task: predict security vulnerabilities in PHP software
note: No abstract, title only (SSRN). Resampling use is not visible from the title; coded as an application from the title's domain prediction task.

task: diagnose cardiac arrhythmia type
note: UCI arrhythmia data; random undersampling and SMOTE, then elastic net feature ranking and one-against-one SVM; contribution is feature identification, no comparison of resampling methods.

task: segment and classify dermoscopic skin lesions
note: Dynamic oversampling of minority images with continuous augmentation (other = augmentation), applied without changing the stored data set; ISIC 2017 validation and test splits; Dice reported (other).

task: predict customer loyalty segment (NPS proxy)
note: Abstract says SMOTE balanced the training set before classification. Labels are derived from clusters of the same features, so perfect scores (F1 = 1.00) are likely circular.

task: predict company bankruptcy
note: Polish companies data; decisions concern firms, not persons. Balanced bagging (which undersamples internally) is one of nine learners; QDA coded other. No measure named.

task: classify malware families
note: SMOTE plus Tomek links, PCA, non-negative tensor decomposition, then one-vs-rest KNN; contribution is the NTD pipeline, no comparison of resampling methods.

task: predict heart disease
note: SMOTE-based balancing (only SMOTE named); stacking and probability-averaging ensembles coded other.

task: detect fraudulent bank account applications
note: SMOTENC oversampling and NearMiss undersampling; recall reported at a decision threshold of 0.30 (threshold tuning visible in the abstract, vs_weights needs full text).

task: classify patients as healthy or epileptic
note: SMOTE and SPIDER (other) used; abstract does not name the data type (EEG likely but not stated) nor the evaluation design; results with and without balancing implied.

task: predict error-prone software modules
note: PROMISE repository; abstract says oversampling but does not name the method; threshold adjustment also examined (relevant to vs_weights with full text).

task: classify human emotions from EEG signals
note: Affective computing / BCI emotion recognition, not a clinical task, so domain other and stakes other. Abstract reports no results or evaluation design.

task: detect intrusions in cloud computing
note: Retracted article. ADASYN then fuzzy deep neural network tuned by chaotic tunicate swarm algorithm; three IDS data sets; no measure named.

task: distinguish smokers from healthy subjects by heart rate variability
note: SMOTE used to generate synthetic HRV feature data (ECG-derived) for a physiological study; ML used as an analysis tool rather than a decision aid, so stakes other. Learners not named.

task: predict Type 2 and gestational diabetes
note: Fifteen models (Extra Trees, RF, LightGBM, XGBoost named); two public data sets evaluated separately; SMOTE-based variants compared against baselines.

task: classify compounds as good or poor transdermal enhancers
note: Abstract says SMOTE oversampled ER > 10 compounds in each training set; Gaussian process (other), KNN, single-layer and RBF networks, SVM; SVM best without resampling. Measures as per-class correct counts and overall success rate.

task: classify breast cancer data
note: PCA with SMOTE, then an ensemble of the best of five unnamed classifiers (coded other); data sets not described beyond high-dimensional breast cancer data; no measure named.

task: flag fraudulent credit card transactions
note: Abstract mentions resampling generically (over- or undersampling) but names only random undersampling at three data set proportions; no SMOTE or oversampling named.

task: predict major adverse cardiovascular events in acute coronary syndrome patients
note: Stacking ensemble (other). Abstract numbers fit a 1:1 test set only: recall 0.975, precision 0.9976 give accuracy, G-mean and AUC 0.9863 at 1:1, accuracy 0.9909 at 2:1. Test likely resampled.

task: classify cancer types from multi-omics data
note: Borderline-SMOTE with Tomek links (coded undersampling), then KPCA/PCA, similarity network, graph attention network and DNN; framed as cancer diagnosis, so medicine; no measure named.

task: detect fraudulent credit card transactions
note: Framework combining unnamed existing sampling algorithms with a hidden Markov model (other) and feature engineering; no new resampler described, no results or evaluation design in the abstract.

task: predict metabolic and pre-metabolic syndrome
note: Korean community cohort (1991 adults); AUC with and without SMOTE reported (gain up to 0.091), so vs_none likely yes with the full text.

task: predict heart disease
note: Cleveland data plus a private data set (503 samples), apparently pooled; SMOTE and SHAP.

task: classify maternal health risk level in pregnancy
note: SMOTE in preprocessing; ANN, RF and a stacking ensemble (ANN + RF + logistic regression, coded other).

task: predict cell-penetrating peptides
note: Abstract says minority ('minor') oversampling was applied within each non-validation fold of stratified 10-fold CV, but does not name the oversampler; metrics not named.

task: detect anomalies in cloud application KPI time series
note: VAE oversampling with no stated change (B2), CNN-LSTM detector is the contribution. Yahoo A1/A2 benchmarks and production KPI data; unclear whether the model was retrained on production data, so internal.

task: detect air pressure system failures in Scania trucks
note: Predictive maintenance of truck components (industry rather than transport); misclassification failure cost is the measure named.

task: predict bank customer subscription in direct marketing
note: UCI Bank Marketing data; SMOTE before classification; J48 and AdaBoost J48 among learners.

task: classify web spam pages
note: Nested rotation forest is the contribution; abstract says SMOTE changes the imbalance ratio of the training set. WEBSPAM-UK2007; no measure named.

task: predict autism spectrum disorder from resting-state fMRI
note: Clustering oversampling (hierarchical clustering, then SMOTE per cluster) is adopted, existing parts; only compared with no oversampling (59.70% to 66.62%), so not own under rule B. Multi-center R-fMRI data, linear SVM.

task: classify nutritional status of toddlers into five categories
note: Single community health center data; SMOTE with decision tree and random forest.

task: predict software refactoring candidates
note: 30 real-world data sets; feature selection (tests, correlation filters, PCA) with SMOTE; abstract says SMOTE boosts performance (comparison with no SMOTE implied); only accuracy named.

task: predict fault-prone software modules
note: BugHunter data set; Lasso feature selection and SMOTE; CNN, RNN, LSTM, KNN, MLP, AdaBoost, XGBoost compared; no measure named as a result.

task: predict hepatitis C stage
note: BSMOTE described as boundary-aware SMOTE, read as Borderline-SMOTE with no stated change; contribution is the feature selection and interaction framework; nested cross-validation.

task: predict overall survival after radiotherapy for hepatocellular carcinoma
note: Radiomics features from multiparametric MRI of 81 patients (19 deceased); contribution is feature selection comparison; SMOTE with random forest.

task: predict heart failure risk
note: Streamlit interface for real-time prediction, but no results from use, so not deployed. Prediction error also reported (other).
